name: Two-Minute Settle
description: Two unhurried minutes: in for four, out for six, then a two-second rest.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A two-minute settle with a rest after each breath, on Breathing Space.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Stop after any round if two minutes is more than you want.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Breathe in as the shape grows and out as it shrinks.
Use the short rest to simply sit. The timer shows how much is left in the paused view.
tips: Breathe in a way that feels easy. If anything feels uncomfortable, stop and breathe normally.
You can pause and come back later. Your place is saved.
